title: Hardware-Aware Learned Representation Compression for Distributed In-Sensor Vision
abstract: arXiv:2609.13947v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In-sensor computing reduces the cost of transmitting high-resolution image data by performing early-stage processing near the sensor. However, the logic chip integrated with a CMOS image sensor (CIS) is tightly constrained in compute and memory, limiting conventional deep neural network partitioning. We present OASIS, a distributed in-sensor vision framework that uses a lightweight encoder to generate compact, task-relevant representations before off-chip transmission. The encoder is trained end-to-end using task, entropy, and reconstruction objectives, while the decoder is used only during training. OASIS supports two complementary deployment paths. The first applies 4-bit quantization and Huffman coding while preserving the spatial structure required by classification and dense-prediction tasks. translated_title: 面向分布式传感器内视觉的硬件感知学习表示压缩
translated_abstract: 传感器内计算通过在传感器附近执行早期处理，降低了传输高分辨率图像数据的成本。然而，与CMOS图像传感器（CIS）集成的逻辑芯片在计算和内存方面受到严格限制，这限制了传统的深度神经网络分割方法。我们提出了OASIS，一个分布式传感器内视觉框架，它在片外传输之前使用轻量级编码器生成紧凑的、与任务相关的表示。该编码器使用任务、熵和重建目标进行端到端训练，而解码器仅在训练期间使用。OASIS支持两种互补的部署路径：第一种采用4比特量化和霍夫曼编码，同时保留分类和密集预测任务所需的空间结构；第二种使用基于Sobol的超维计算（HDC）将编码器的潜在表示转换为固定维度的二进制超向量。
tldr: OASIS是一个分布式传感器内视觉框架，利用轻量级编码器在片外传输前生成紧凑的任务相关表示，并通过4比特量化与超维计算两种硬件感知部署路径，解决了传感器内芯片计算和内存受限的难题。
en_tdlr: OASIS is a hardware-aware distributed in-sensor vision framework that uses a lightweight encoder to generate compact, task-relevant representations before off-chip transmission, offering both 4-bit quantization and hyperdimensional computing deployment paths to overcome tight compute and memory constraints on sensor-integrated logic chips.
